about: CANDIDATE test conditions found by searching NASA's PSI files (scripts/fetch_psi_raw.py, scripts/summarize_raw.py; see docs/RAW_DATA_FINDINGS.md). Same shape as solid_conditions.json. NOT verified and NOT applied: nothing here reaches tests.json, the app or any count until workstream A has opened the source and the team agrees.

facts.kind: stated control range of ISS cabin air, not a reading for any burn
facts.source_title: Smoke Point in Co-flow Experiment (SPICE): Laminar Smoke Point Properties of Non-buoyant Round-Jet Diffusion Flames, Final Report (Urban, Sunderland et al.)
facts.location: p. 19 (pdftotext page count; confirm in the PDF)
facts.quote: after each two such burns the MSG contents were flushed with ISS cabin air. The oxygen mole fraction of this cabin air is maintained within 19 - 24%.
facts.quote_note: The dash between 19 and 24 is a glyph pdftotext cannot read (byte 0xFF); check it in the PDF.
caveats: A range NASA keeps the cabin within, not a measurement during SPICE. Not usable as a per-test o2_fraction.
The same report's Table 1 footnote says flow parameters 'assume conditions of 298 K, 101 kPa and 21+-1% O2': an assumption for a calculation, not a measured pressure. Do not use it as pressure.
